rider_advocate.claim_restated: The driver cancelled four minutes after arriving, before the five-minute free wait ended and well before the eight-minute no-show threshold, so the $5.00 fee was charged too early and should be reversed.

counter_arguments.argument: The driver was at the pickup bay and messaged the rider.
counter_arguments.response: Being there is not enough: the fare evidence shows only four minutes elapsed from arrival, so neither the free wait nor the no-show threshold had passed when the driver cancelled.

driver_advocate.author: driver_advocate
driver_advocate.claim_restated: The driver arrived on time, stayed at the pickup bay and messaged the rider, who gave no position, so the driver was entitled to cancel for a rider no-show.

counter_arguments.argument: Only four minutes passed after arrival, which is less than the five-minute free wait.
counter_arguments.response: The rider's one message gave no location or arrival time, so the driver could not tell when the rider would reach the bay.

argument_assessments.reason: The fare evidence shows four minutes from arrival to cancellation, under the five-minute free wait and the eight-minute threshold.
The driver's presence is not disputed, but it does not make up the missing wait time.
The driver cancelled before the free wait ended, so the conditions for a no-show charge were not met.
The rider gave no position, but that does not shorten the wait the driver must give.

judge.policy_fit_reason: The thresholds in the fare evidence were not reached, so the fee does not apply.
judge.reasoning_summary: The driver cancelled after four minutes, before the five-minute free wait or the eight-minute no-show threshold. The fee was charged too early and is reversed in full.
